title: 'Prepare to depart': US embassies issue alert across Middle East amid Iran tensions
content: US embassies in Middle East urged citizens to depart due to potential conflict escalation.  The security alerts warned of unpredictable Iranian actions and possible attacks on US interests.  President Trump threatened Iran with severe military action following alleged truce violations.  Iran warned countries supporting the US against facing war's flames.  Regional shipping and travel face disruptions amid ongoing hostilities and heightened tensions.

title: NEET-PG 2026 gets major overhaul: Centres closer to home, single-shift exam, fewer questions
content: NEET-PG exam sees significant changes for candidate convenience and enhanced security. Candidates now select three preferred states for their examination centre locations. The exam duration remains the same, but questions reduce to 180 for more time. Aadhaar and iris biometrics strengthen registration and exam day security measures. NEET-PG 2026 will be conducted in a single shift for uniform assessment.

title: 6 killed in Kerala as heavy rain triggers landslides, floods; IMD issues red alert
content: Heavy rains lashed Kerala on Saturday, causing landslides and widespread flooding. Six people died in rain-related incidents, with several others rescued from affected areas. Authorities launched large-scale rescue and evacuation operations, setting up numerous relief camps for displaced residents. Landslides and flooding disrupted traffic and damaged many houses across several districts. The India Meteorological Department issued red and orange alerts for multiple districts forecasting heavy rainfall.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
content: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

The activist questioned the unregistered CJP's operation as a political party. He asked the Election Commission to verify the CJP's registration status. title: 'Screams, sudden death': 16-year-old girl's body exhumed 52 days after burial in UP

Suspicious circumstances surrounding her death prompted the district administration to order a fresh investigation. A local resident alleged hearing screams and later learned of the girl's sudden death. Following his complaint and death threat claims, authorities ordered the exhumation for examination. The body has now been sent for a post-mortem as police begin their detailed inquiry.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
content: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.

title: Michigan woman sues Toll Brothers over access to her 19-acre property

Her property, undeveloped, is situated between two upcoming luxury housing estates. The lawsuit alleges that the developers have disregarded her property rights and neglected environmental regulations. She aims to reinstate her access easement and challenge the site plan approvals.

title: Man buys back grandfather’s 1953 tractor 62 years later, restores it
content: Kevin Klahn restored his grandfather's 1953 tractor after buying it back.  This vintage Allis-Chalmers WD tractor became a symbol of family heritage.  The meticulous restoration project took many hours of dedicated work.  It preserved the machine's original character and historical significance.  The tractor returned home, representing dedication and enduring family bonds.

title: World's largest digital camera captures more than 500,000 galaxies in deep view of universe

Astronomers have studied this specific sky region for over two decades. The observatory's new camera provides unparalleled depth and coverage of the universe. Future observations will reveal even fainter galaxies and cosmic events.

title: How Lamine Yamal’s parents shaped football’s most emotional World Cup story
content: Lamine Yamal's rise to winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup is inseparable from the story of the family that built him. His mother Sheila Ebana was 16 when she gave birth to him. His father Mounir, a Moroccan immigrant, worked construction and street jobs to stay afloat. His grandmother Fátima crossed from Morocco to Spain alone, undocumented, and worked three jobs to bring her children over. His father survived a life-threatening stabbing in August 2024. Yamal's name itself honours two strangers who helped his parents financially before he was born. This is the full human story behind the boy who hugged his little brother on a World Cup pitch in New Jersey.
